$description: HyperCard design tokens. Every dimension is a whole CSS pixel at 1x (the classic Mac's 72 dpi point). Sources and confidence per value are in research/. The 'hc' prefix is reserved for this system.

color.$description: HyperCard is 1-bit. There are exactly two colors. Gray never exists as a color; it is a pattern (see pattern.*) or a dither mask.

card.$description: The card is the unit of layout. HyperCard 1.x cards are exactly 512x342; 2.x allows other sizes with width a multiple of 16.

width-step.$description: 2.x card widths and window x positions snap to multiples of 16.

font.$description: Roles, not families. Chicago 12 is the system font (menus, titles, button names). Geneva 12 is text (fields, Message box). Monaco 9 is the script font. Geneva 9 is small utility text. New York is the serif.

chicago.$description: HC Chicago is the @font-face in css/fonts.css that maps to a pixel recreation (Chicago Kare) when present; Krungthep/Silom ship with macOS and carry Chicago's Latin glyphs.

geneva.$description: Apple's Geneva.ttf ships with macOS and covers Vietnamese.

serif.$description: New York stand-in; Apple's New York is unreachable from Chromium.

size.$description: The classic Style menu sizes. Points equal pixels.

line-height.$description: ascent + descent + leading, from the real bitmap strikes.

hairline.$description: Every border is 1 px black unless a component says otherwise.

thick.$description: Pressed check box / radio frame; dialog inner border.

shadow.$description: Shadows are hard, black, offset right and down. Never blurred.

part.$description: HyperCard shadow-style buttons and fields, and the round-rect button.

icon.$description: Drop shadow on Susan Kare's block arrows and card stacks.

roundrect.$description: HyperCard 1.x round-rect button corner (arc diameter 14, medium confidence).

standard.$description: Toolbox push button: oval = min(width, height/2) = 10 for a 20 px button.

height.$description: 19 white rows plus a 1 px black bottom line.

padding-x.$description: Text of the first title starts 7 px in.

titlebar-height.$description: Rows 0-18 counted from the window's top frame line, the line above the content on row 18. .hc-titlebar sits under the frame line, so it is 18 px including that line.

title-padding.$description: White gap between the title text and the stripes on each side.

box-size.$description: Close and zoom boxes: 11x11 hollow squares in a 13x13 cell.

box-inset.$description: From the frame line to the box outline, both sides: 8 px of white inside the frame, then the box.

dialog.$description: Modal dialog (dBoxProc) double outline, from the outside in: 1 black, 2 white, 2 black, 3 white.

padding-x.$description: Minimum on each side of the name.

ring-outset.$description: Ring outer edge sits 4 px outside the button (3 px ring + 1 px gap).

line-pitch.$description: textHeight default = trunc(4/3 * textSize) = 16 for Geneva 12; showLines rules land on each baseline.

track-pattern.$description: 25% dither per Executor; many recreations wrongly use 50%.

margin.$description: Glyphs sit roughly centered with 2-4 px margin.

effect.$description: HyperCard visual effects. Apple never published durations; these are this system's interpretation, tuned so 'normal' reads as a deliberate transition on a modern screen.

fps.$description: Effects step in discrete frames; a Mac Plus redrew in stages, not at 60 fps.

dissolve-cell.$description: Ordered dither over an 8x8 tile, densest last.
